analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (222,000 KRW) above SMA5 (217,700 KRW), below SMA20 (241,175 KRW): short-term momentum weakening, below mid-term trend.
· Below SMA100 (272,380 KRW) and SMA200 (235,516 KRW): long-term trend weak.
· 52-week position (52.2%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.9 → 40.9): exiting oversold, now ranging in neutral zone, weak directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6408.1700 → -2113.6200): improvement confirmed, entering weak consolidation.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 241,175 KRW): ranging near mid-band, band width at 42.71% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at 204,500 KRW: based on Pivot S1 (188,500 KRW) and 20-day low (203,500 KRW).
· Swing resistance at 223,000 KRW: below 5-day high (228,000 KRW) and Pivot PP (237,000 KRW).
· 5-day/20-day price patterns - 5-day high 228,000 KRW, 20-day high 285,500 KRW, 5-day low 203,500 KRW, 20-day low 203,500 KRW: Higher Low pattern not formed, sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.97x): normal compared to 5-day average, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI neutral range, weak ADX trend, need to confirm breakout above 223,000 KRW swing resistance before entry decision.
